password_hint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.
live_exams_count: {count, plural, one {# live exam} other {# live exams}}
users_hero_body: Approval happens here and nowhere else. Examiners cannot author, grade or view proctoring — and candidates cannot see or sit an exam — until you approve them.
no_users_match_body: Adjust the filters or clear the search.
reset_password_body: Set a new password for {name} ({email}). They are not notified — share the new password with them yourself.
create_user_hint: Accounts you create here are approved immediately. This is the only route to an administrator account.
error_load_audit: Could not load the audit log.
audit_body: Registrations, sittings and published results, newest first - the same feed the dashboard's activity panel reads from.
audit_empty_body: Platform events will appear here as the system is used.
reports_body: A platform-wide view over exams, candidates and proctoring, drawn from the same data every other page reads.
reports_exams_summary: {exams, plural, one {# exam} other {# exams}} on the platform, {live} live right now, {completed} completed.
reports_candidates_summary: {count, plural, one {# registered candidate.} other {# registered candidates.}}
reports_candidates_note: Attempts, completion and average scores are on the candidate roster.
reports_flagged_summary: {count, plural, one {# sitting flagged} other {# sittings flagged}} for review across the platform.
reports_performance_body: Difficulty and topic breakdowns are computed per exam. Open an exam to see its analytics.
reports_export_body: Certified result PDFs are available today, one candidate at a time, from that candidate's own result. Platform-wide bulk exports (CSV/Excel across a whole report) are not built yet.
health_body: What is actually checkable from the server, and nothing invented for what isn't.
health_hint_api: This request answering at all is the check.
health_hint_storage: A live check against the object store.
health_hint_websocket: Proctoring + live-monitoring sockets are registered routes.
health_hint_ai_proctoring: Vision inference runs in the candidate's browser during a sitting.
health_hint_authentication: This page only loaded because a valid admin token was verified.
candidates_body: Everyone who can sit your papers, with their attempt history and how proctoring rated each sitting.
no_attempts_body: This candidate has not sat any of your papers yet.
error_password_rule: New password must be at least 8 characters with a letter and a digit.
error_password_mismatch: New password and confirm password don't match.
identity_note: Your email is your sign-in identity and your role is an administrator's decision, so neither is edited here.
access_hint_candidate: Your account and your permission to use the platform are separate.
access_hint_other: What your role is allowed to reach.
candidate_access_note: Your account was created active when you registered. Permission to use the platform is granted separately by an administrator or an examiner who runs a paper you are enrolled in.
session_body: You stay signed in on this device until you sign out or your refresh token expires. Sign out on any shared or public machine when you finish.
error_passwords_no_match: The two passwords do not match.
reset_link_issued: A reset link was issued to your email address. Follow it to finish changing your password.
toast_account_created_candidate: Account created. Sign in to request access.
toast_account_created_examiner: Account created — an administrator must approve it
login_tagline: AI-powered proctoring, randomized papers, automated grading — and a human examiner reviews every decision.
toast_password_updated_sign_in: Password updated — sign in with your new password
reset_token_placeholder: Paste the token from the message above
awaiting_revoked_body: An administrator has withdrawn your access to the platform.
awaiting_body_examiner: Your examiner account exists, but an administrator has to approve it before you can use the platform.
awaiting_body_candidate: Your candidate account exists, but an administrator has to approve it before you can use the platform.
awaiting_revoked_detail: You can still sign in, but the platform will refuse every action. Contact your administrator if you believe this is a mistake.
awaiting_next_examiner: An administrator sees your request on their dashboard. Approval is theirs alone to give — no other examiner can grant it. Once they do, sign out and back in to pick up the change immediately.
awaiting_next_candidate: An administrator sees your request on their dashboard. Approval is theirs alone to give — no other candidate can grant it. Once they do, sign out and back in to pick up the change immediately.
awaiting_hint_examiner: Once an administrator approves your examiner account.
awaiting_hint_candidate: Once an administrator approves your candidate account.
cap_examiner_1: Author MCQ, multi-select, short, long and handwritten-upload questions
cap_examiner_2: Configure exams: duration, window, randomization and negative marking
cap_examiner_3: Review provisional scores on written answers and override them
cap_examiner_4: Watch live proctoring and inspect flagged sessions with snapshots
cap_candidate_1: See the exams published for you and the window each one opens in
cap_candidate_2: Sit a randomized paper generated for you alone, with autosave throughout
cap_candidate_3: Upload photographed handwritten answers where a question asks for them
cap_candidate_4: Read your result with question-level feedback once it is published
